name: The Dark Sea
about: Black water under a gale, rolling in big swells to the edge of the fog. The Landing (where you arrive) with the Tide Door back to the void and the Sky Door up to orbit; a lantern-lit pier north to the Lighthouse; stacks of basalt standing out of the sea, an arch, and a wreck in the shallows to the east. Made by tools/assets/build_sea.py.
